title: Charles de Poupet, sieur de La Chaulx, to Charles V, Vitoria, 28 May 1522 (DECODE R1187)

documents.shelfmark: Biblioteca Nacional de España, MSS/20212/39/1-2; DECODE R1187

plaintext.source: Contemporary decipherment, MSS/20212/39/2, keyed by margin letters A, b, C, D, E to the five cipher passages (DECODE images 9-11).

transcription.source: Authenticated DECODE scans of R1187 (11 openings, ~2190 px wide).
transcription.notes: Only the first cipher line of passage A transcribed; decipherment sections A and b transcribed (M).

system.summary: Homophonic substitution of French in graphic signs and digits, no word division; five marked passages.
system.notes: e has at least three signs in the first line; key not rebuilt.

prior_solution.where: The 1522 decipherment bound with the letter, MSS/20212/39/2.

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.

solution.what: Fetched the 11 DECODE images with the stored cookie.
Web and archive.org search for a printed edition (Gachard 1859 Charles-Quint/Adrien VI).
Identified images 9-11 as a contemporary decipherment keyed A-E to the five marked cipher passages; letter is French, dated Vitoria 28 May 1522, not Spanish 1 Jan.
Aligned the first line of passage A with the decipherment: sign counts fit combien/que/je, e homophonic.
Transcribed decipherment sections A and b.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary decipherment bound with the letter as BNE MSS/20212/39/2 gives all five cipher passages; it was aligned against the first cipher line of passage A but the key was not rebuilt.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; key not rebuilt.
